title: Measure spaces and positive measures
description: Countably additive set functions on a σ-algebra; monotonicity, countable subadditivity, continuity from below and (with a finiteness hypothesis) from above; counting and Dirac measures as first examples.

title: Monotone convergence, Fatou and dominated convergence
description: The three limit theorems for the Lebesgue integral with their hypotheses: increasing nonnegative sequences, the Fatou inequality, domination by an integrable function; counterexamples when a hypothesis is dropped.

title: Null sets, almost-everywhere equality and completion
description: Sets of measure zero, properties holding almost everywhere, equality of integrals for a.e.-equal functions, L^1 as classes of functions, completion of a measure space.

title: Riemann versus Lebesgue integral
description: Lebesgue's criterion (Riemann integrable iff continuous almost everywhere), agreement of the two integrals for Riemann integrable functions, and functions integrable in one sense only.

title: Cantor sets, non-measurable sets and the structure of Lebesgue measure
description: The Carathéodory criterion, the Cantor set, Lebesgue measurable sets that are not Borel, a non-measurable set built from translation invariance, invariance of Lebesgue measure under translations, dilations and rotations.

title: Riesz representation theorem for positive linear functionals
description: Positive linear functionals on compactly supported continuous functions are integration against a regular Borel measure; the Lebesgue integral as the completion of the Riemann integral.

title: Lusin's and Egoroff's theorems
description: Measurable functions are nearly continuous (Lusin), pointwise convergence is nearly uniform (Egoroff); approximation of measurable functions by continuous functions; the Vitali–Carathéodory theorem.

title: Modes of convergence
description: Convergence almost everywhere, in measure and in L^p; the implications between them, subsequence extraction, and dominated convergence under convergence in measure.

title: Jensen, Hölder and Minkowski inequalities
description: Convex functions and Jensen's inequality; Hölder's and Minkowski's inequalities for conjugate exponents; the generalised Minkowski inequality.

title: Product measures and Fubini's theorem
description: Product σ-algebras and product measures; Fubini and Tonelli for nonnegative and integrable functions on R^n and on general products; completion of product measures.

title: Convolution, Young's inequality and mollifiers
description: Convolution of integrable functions, Young's inequality, approximate identities and mollifiers, density of smooth functions in L^p.

title: Lebesgue differentiation and the fundamental theorem of calculus
description: Vitali covering, the Hardy–Littlewood maximal function and its weak (1,1) bound, Lebesgue's differentiation theorem, Lebesgue points, and the fundamental theorem of calculus for the Lebesgue integral.
